This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing. No project revision, validation or solve job was created.

The model list has no reverse-osmosis unit and no pressure-exchanger unit. The nearest models are a generic pump, mixer, splitter, valve, heater and flash. Building the RO and the pressure exchanger from those would replace the case's units with different ones, which the instructions forbid.

- **`ReverseOsmosis0D` (`fs.RO`):** Nothing models membrane water recovery, permeate and retentate outlets, or a pressure change across the membrane.
- **`PressureExchanger` (`fs.PXR`):** Nothing models a brine-to-feed pressure transfer with a stated efficiency.

I did not check the NaCl property method (`NaClParameterBlock`) or the H2O and NaCl components, because the missing units already block the build.

{"case_id": "blind_synthesized_ro_pressure_exchanger", "status": "limitation", "revision_id": null, "job_id": null, "limitation": {"reasons": [{"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "fs.RO"}, {"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "fs.PXR"}], "explanation": "list_models offers no reverse-osmosis membrane unit (ReverseOsmosis0D with water recovery, permeate/retentate outlets and pressure change) and no pressure exchanger (PressureExchanger with brine/feed inlets and outlets and an efficiency). Only generic pump, mixer, splitter, valve, heater and flash models exist, so building the case would need substitute units. Nothing was built."}, "claims": []}
```
